research.title: Remix 3 Threw Out React. Six Weeks With the Beta.
research.whyTrending: Remix 3 beta preview (April 30, 2026) drops React entirely — no virtual DOM, no build-time magic, a forked Preact underneath, JSX with explicit updates instead of hooks. There is no migration path from Remix v2, whose good parts were folded into React Router v7 instead. Stable targeted for early 2026 and still not production ready. The takes online are all reactions to the announcement; nobody has actually built something and reported back. Controversial, high-volume, and the blog has no Remix 3 coverage at all.
research.gapNote: Zero coverage. Natural companion to the existing Next.js vs Astro decision posts.
